//: Non-secret defaults matching deploy/docker-compose.yml service names. Real values arrive as environment variables (ConnectionStrings__Postgres and friends); nothing here is a credential.

Keycloak.//MaxAccessTokenLifetimeSeconds: Must match the realm (deploy/keycloak/realm-export.json). It is how long a revocation entry survives, so a smaller value here would let a revoked token start working again before it expired.
Keycloak.//RevocationSweepSeconds: How often open hub connections are re-checked. FR-003 allows five minutes; 30s leaves an order of magnitude of margin for directory-sync propagation.

Authorization.//MembershipCacheTtlSeconds: Principle VII caps authorization data at 60s; research.md D6 chose 30. Values outside 1..60 are refused at startup.
